sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You draw a special fuinjutsu symbol onto yourself allowing yourself to slip into and out of a pocket dimension of your creation. At the end of each of your turns, roll a d8. On a roll of 5 or higher, you vanish from your current location, appearing in your pocket dimension.

At the start of your next turn, and when the jutsu ends, you return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space chosen at random.

While in your pocket dimension. You can only see shades of gray, and you can’t see further than 60 feet away from the space you vanished. While in this pocket dimension, you cannot interact with the material dimension in anyway. If you end concentration of this jutsu early while you are in this pocket dimension, you return to the material plane following this jutsu’s effect at the beginning of your following turn.
